orientations.intent: Determine whether the frozen tools can query a remote Go module proxy for this dependency.

final_message: No — the frozen tools available in this environment do not include any network/remote access capability (no HTTP/proxy fetch verb exists on the repo handle or others); only local repository operations like status are supported. So they cannot query a remote Go module proxy for this dependency.

files.content:
package core
func Name() string { return "local-core" }
The core dependency is provided by the local deps/core module.

module example.test/mapapp

go 1.22

require example.test/core v0.0.0
replace example.test/core => ./deps/core
